sbir-validator.description: Independent reviewer subagent that validates SBIR proposals against Layer 1 (BAA Preface) and Layer 2 (component-specific) rules. Returns structured PASS/CONDITIONAL_PASS/FAIL verdict and writes a marker file. Read-only against proposal content. Invoked by rfp-agent as Step 5 of SBIR Mode workflow, or manually after a hand-written draft.
capabilities: Layer 2 component-specific rule validation (11 checks, dynamic per component)
Structured verdict returned for programmatic consumption by rfp-agent
sbir-validator.invocation: Invoked by rfp-agent via Agent tool with subagent_type='sbir-validator', OR manually by user after hand-written drafts.
sbir-validator.tools_restricted: Read, Grep, Glob, Write (marker + report only), Bash — NO Edit (cannot modify proposal content)

proposal-tracker.description: Cross-proposal open-item tracker. Scans every PROPOSAL_TEAM/outputs/<topic_id>/ folder, extracts open items from PARTNER_CHECKLIST.md + sbir_validation_report.md + [USER VERIFY] / [PLACEHOLDER] markers, and maintains PROPOSAL_TEAM/outputs/PROPOSAL_TRACKER.xlsx (4-sheet workbook: Master / By Owner / By Topic / Summary). Source of truth is the .md files; Excel is a derived view. Also handles Q&A queries about open items across all proposals.
capabilities: Scans all output topic folders matching SBIR topic-ID pattern
Extracts open items from 4 source types (checklist / validator report / placeholders / lookup)
Heuristic categorization by owner (Rasheed / EZ / Cyber SME / Bola / Breion / joint)
Priority inference (CRITICAL / HIGH / WARNING / MEDIUM / INFO)
Q&A over the tracker (e.g. 'what's open on NV004?', 'what does Rasheed owe?')
Auto-fires via .claude/hooks/proposal_tracker_trigger.ps1 on validator marker writes
proposal-tracker.invocation: Manually: 'update the tracker' / 'what's open on X?' / 'what does <owner> owe?'. Automatically: PostToolUse hook fires the underlying tools/proposal_tracker.py script on any .sbir_validation_* marker write.
